title.zh: 安扳嘉 · 白雷站场与反向快支
title.en: Soldier 0 / Trigger / Astra · White Thunder and reverse assists

summary.zh: 嘉音驻唱，扳机补绝意与协战，安比连续消耗白雷；只在辅助需要刷新时交棒。
summary.en: Astra sustains Cadenza, Trigger stocks Purge/support, and Soldier 0 spends White Thunder continuously; switch for needed refreshes.

conditions.zh: 循环站位嘉音→零号安比→扳机；嘉音的下一位与扳机的上一位都是安比。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Astra → Soldier 0 → Trigger; both Astra’s next slot and Trigger’s previous slot are Soldier 0.

conditions.zh: 使用未开启潜能觉醒的基础安比，不加入苍光·临界；2影扩展单列。
conditions.en: Uses Soldier 0 without Awakening; White Thunder - Critical is excluded and M2 extensions are separate.

conditions.zh: 嘉音Q会把接下来两次快支替换成连携；发生时跟实际提示，完成后重查资源，不套用快支事件。
conditions.en: Astra Ultimate replaces the next two Quick Assists with Chains; follow the real prompt and recheck resources instead of treating them as these assist events.

conditions.zh: 作者旧版本教学与固定3.3基础机制交叉核对；不继承旧伤害排名、最高分、固定秒数或潜能觉醒变招。
conditions.en: Older authored methods are cross-checked against fixed 3.3 base mechanics; old rankings, score claims, fixed timings and Awakening variants are excluded.

label.zh: HoYo青枫 · 零号安比白雷循环（1.6）
label.en: HoYo Qingfeng · Soldier 0 White Thunder loop (1.6)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 安扳嘉站位与协战（1.6）
label.en: Little Orange · Soldier 0 / Trigger / Astra and support (1.6)

label.zh: HoYo青枫 · 耀嘉音支援与和弦（1.5）
label.en: HoYo Qingfeng · Astra assists and Chords (1.5)

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先建辅助，再把站场交给安比。
objective.en: Establish support, then give Soldier 0 the field.

title.zh: 嘉音点按特殊技，建立驻唱
title.en: Tap Astra Special to establish Idyllic Cadenza

input.zh: 点按特殊技，命中后等待目标快支提示
input.en: Tap Special, hit, and wait for the intended Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 尚未驻唱或需要重新定位；无须先有25能量才能进入驻唱。
trigger.en: Not in Cadenza, or repositioning is needed; entering it does not itself require 25 energy.

complete.zh: 确认驻唱和对应快支；有和弦并实际耗能的接手才给核心加攻。
complete.en: Confirm Cadenza and the matching assist; the core ATK buff needs an actual energy-consuming entry.

reason.zh: 驻唱增伤与耗能加攻是两个条件；不要将一次普通切人计为全部增益已满。
reason.en: Cadenza bonuses and the energy-paid ATK buff have separate conditions; a normal switch does not prove both.

fallback.zh: 已有驻唱且覆盖足够则跳过；提示不符不强按。若刚开过嘉音Q，按实际连携提示处理。
fallback.en: Skip if Cadenza already covers the window. Do not force a mismatched prompt; after Astra Ultimate use the actual Chain prompt.

signal.zh: 命中后按目标角色的快支提示接手。
signal.en: After the hit, accept the intended character’s Quick Assist prompt.

title.zh: 主攻接嘉音快支，核对加攻
title.en: Main attacker takes Astra Quick Assist; check ATK

input.zh: 按嘉音对应快支提示入场
input.en: Enter through Astra’s matching Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 快支提示真实可用；若要刷新核心加攻，嘉音须驻唱并实际消耗25能量。
trigger.en: The Quick Assist prompt is available; refreshing core ATK requires active Cadenza and 25 energy actually spent.

complete.zh: 完成快支；核对核心加攻，随后按本队资源步骤继续。
complete.en: Complete the assist, verify core ATK, then continue the team’s resource setup.

reason.zh: 精准支援增强嘉音协同攻击，但普通有效快支也能在耗能后触发加攻。
reason.en: Precise Assist strengthens Astra’s follow-up; an ordinary valid Quick Assist can still grant ATK when energy is spent.

fallback.zh: 嘉音Q后的替代连携不是本快支事件；按对应连携完成后重查资源，不自动算满。
fallback.en: A Chain replacing this assist after Astra Ultimate is not this event; finish the actual Chain and recheck resources.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 状态仍在；加攻另需耗能支援入场
label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

title.zh: 扳机补绝意，再反向交回安比
title.en: Refill Trigger Purge, then return to Soldier 0

input.zh: 普通切扳机；长按普攻狙击，资源足够后松开
input.en: Switch normally to Trigger; hold Basic to snipe, then release once stocked

trigger.zh: 绝意不足才补；狙击命中才能回绝意，留安全攻击位置。
trigger.en: Refill only when Purge is low. Shots must hit to restore it; choose a safe firing position.

complete.zh: 核对真实绝意；松手终结一击命中且25秒限制可用，才有上一位安比快支。
complete.en: Read actual Purge. The released finisher must hit and its 25-second limit be ready to call previous-slot Soldier 0.

reason.zh: 作者用短暂狙击补足后台追击库存；最后一击不回绝意，不把四次按键当作四次命中。
reason.en: The author briefly stocks off-field follow-ups. The finisher does not grant Purge; four inputs do not prove four hits.

fallback.zh: 绝意足够跳过；无反向快支提示时正常交回安比，且不记为快支加攻刷新。
fallback.en: Skip when stocked. Without the reverse-assist prompt, switch back normally without crediting an assist ATK refresh.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 状态仍在；加攻另需耗能支援入场
label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

signal.zh: 狙击终结一击命中后，接受上一位安比的真实快支提示。
signal.en: After the sniper finisher hits, accept previous-slot Soldier 0’s actual Quick Assist prompt.

title.en: Soldier 0 takes Trigger’s reverse Quick Assist

input.zh: 按扳机触发的上一位快支提示
input.en: Use Trigger’s previous-slot Quick Assist prompt

trigger.zh: 上一招已给出安比的快支；若无提示，正常切人不执行本事件。
trigger.en: Trigger gave Soldier 0 the matching prompt; a normal switch without it is not this event.

complete.zh: 完成快支；核对核心加攻，随后按本队资源步骤继续。
complete.en: Complete the assist, verify core ATK, then continue the team’s resource setup.

reason.zh: 反向快支迅速交还站场权；嘉音仍驻唱并有和弦时可同时刷新入场加攻。
reason.en: The reverse assist returns field time; active Astra Cadenza with Chords can also refresh entry ATK.

fallback.zh: 嘉音Q后的替代连携不是本快支事件；按对应连携完成后重查资源，不自动算满。
fallback.en: A Chain replacing this assist after Astra Ultimate is not this event; finish the actual Chain and recheck resources.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 状态仍在；加攻另需耗能支援入场
label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

label.zh: 协奏狙杀 · 实际命中、绝意或协战次数及冷却均满足
label.en: Harmonizing Shot · actual hits, Purge/support uses and cooldowns required

title.zh: 安比长按EX，命中补满银星
title.en: Hold Soldier 0 EX and hit to refill Silver Star

trigger.zh: 能量足够；先用掉目标现有可用白雷／电鸣，避免白雷资源溢出。
trigger.en: Enough energy; first spend usable White Thunder/Thunder on the target to avoid wasting its refill.

complete.zh: 招式命中后查看目标银星／白雷，确认实际可用层数。
complete.en: After the move hits, inspect the target’s actual Silver Star/White Thunder stacks.

reason.zh: EX提供快速充能；扳机冥狱须本次重击命中、有绝意且该类型触发额度仍可用。
reason.en: EX rapidly charges the mark. Trigger Tartarus needs this heavy hit, Purge and an available trigger allowance for this move type.

fallback.zh: 缺能量以普攻或合法闪反充能；未命中就重新找目标，不预记三层。
fallback.en: Use Basics or a valid Dodge Counter if energy is low; a miss requires reacquiring the target, not assuming three stacks.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 状态仍在；加攻另需耗能支援入场
label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

label.zh: 协奏狙杀 · 实际命中、绝意或协战次数及冷却均满足
label.en: Harmonizing Shot · actual hits, Purge/support uses and cooldowns required

title.zh: 同一目标连续三次苍光，触发雷殛
title.en: Three White Thunder slashes on one target for Thunder Smite

input.zh: 对白雷足够的同一目标，连续点按三次特殊技
input.en: On one target with enough White Thunder, tap Special three times consecutively

trigger.zh: 目标仍有白雷；0影需本组足够三层，2影须另检查电鸣替代消耗。
trigger.en: The target still has White Thunder; M0 needs three for this group. At M2, separately track Thunder substitution.

complete.zh: 三次实际额外伤害连续触发后，核对雷殛与剩余层数。
complete.en: After three consecutive actual extra-damage triggers, verify Thunder Smite and remaining stacks.

reason.zh: 作者强调同一目标连续触发；不能将打空、跨目标或断开的三次输入视为完成。
reason.en: The author requires a consecutive sequence on one target; misses, different targets or broken strings do not prove completion.

fallback.zh: 目标离场或连段中断时保命并重查层数；不要为赶进度切人打断本组。
fallback.en: If the target leaves or the string breaks, stay safe and recheck stacks; do not interrupt the group just to follow a schedule.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 状态仍在；加攻另需耗能支援入场
label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

label.zh: 协奏狙杀 · 实际命中、绝意或协战次数及冷却均满足
label.en: Harmonizing Shot · actual hits, Purge/support uses and cooldowns required

prep.zh: 开局狙击只在绝意不足时做；已有库存或其他资源就绪可按条件跳过。
prep.en: Opening sniping is only needed with low Purge; skip according to actual stock/readiness.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 普攻补标记、三苍光消耗；按需补一次协战。
objective.en: Build the mark with Basics, spend three slashes, and refresh support when needed.

title.zh: 普攻补银星，第四段可继续突进
title.en: Build Silver Star with Basics and hit-four dashes

input.zh: 普攻至第四段命中后连点或长按，按实际层数停手
input.en: After Basic hit four lands, tap repeatedly or hold; stop according to actual stacks

trigger.zh: 白雷未够下一组，且当前没有更合适的EX／终结技回复。
trigger.en: Not enough White Thunder for the next group and no more suitable EX/Ultimate refill is available.

complete.zh: 核对当前目标银星；满三层即可转苍光，不凭固定两套普攻判满。
complete.en: Inspect this target’s Silver Star; move to White Thunder at three stacks rather than assuming two strings always fill it.

reason.zh: 普攻补资源同时给扳机提供符合条件的追击命中。
reason.en: Basics rebuild resources and provide qualifying hits for Trigger’s follow-ups.

fallback.zh: 已有三层直接消耗；敌人出招时合法闪避／闪反，不硬吃伤害打完整套。
fallback.en: Spend three existing stacks immediately; dodge or counter real attacks instead of forcing a full string.

label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

title.zh: 需要时扳机EX补协战，再交回
title.en: Refresh Trigger support with EX when needed

input.zh: 普通切扳机，能量足够时点按强化特殊技
input.en: Switch normally to Trigger and tap EX with enough energy

trigger.zh: 需要补协战或失衡、能量足够且目标可命中；已有充足覆盖可跳过。
trigger.en: Support or Daze is needed, energy suffices and the target is hittable; skip if already covered.

complete.zh: 命中后获得协战并出现上一位安比快支；绝意与协战次数分别检查。
complete.en: A hit establishes Coordinated Support and previous-slot Soldier 0’s assist; track Purge and support uses separately.

reason.zh: 协战让普通协奏狙杀免绝意；冥狱仍消耗绝意，不能把所有追击当作免费。
reason.en: Support makes regular Harmonizing Shot free; Tartarus still spends Purge. Not every follow-up becomes free.

fallback.zh: 缺能量时按真实绝意继续后台；绝意不足回狙击步骤，不为固定循环空按EX。
fallback.en: With low energy, continue from actual Purge; snipe if it is low instead of forcing EX.

prep.zh: 辅助覆盖够时跳过扳机EX与接手，不要见到嘉音快支就切，避免白雷连段中断和能量浪费。
prep.en: Skip Trigger EX/entry when already covered. Do not take every Astra prompt at the cost of a broken White Thunder string or wasted energy.

prep.zh: 绝意不足回狙击步骤；协战普通追击免费并不让冥狱也免费。
prep.en: Return to sniping when Purge is low; free normal support shots do not make Tartarus free.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: Q补充→分组消耗→EX补充→再消耗。
objective.en: Ultimate refill → grouped spending → EX refill → spending again.

title.zh: 终结技命中补银星，准备集中消耗
title.en: Hit with Ultimate, then concentrate White Thunder spending

trigger.zh: 终结技实际就绪、辅助覆盖足够；先消耗旧白雷，目标与窗口可用。
trigger.en: Ultimate is actually ready, support coverage suffices, and old stacks are spent; target and window are available.

complete.zh: 命中后核对满层银星；2影另获得6电鸣，不等于6白雷。
complete.en: After the hit verify Silver Star; M2 additionally grants six Thunder stacks, which are distinct from White Thunder.

reason.zh: 终结技与EX分别补资源，分段用掉再补，避免一次性覆盖库存。
reason.en: Ultimate and EX are separate refills; spend between them instead of overwriting resources.

fallback.zh: 未就绪直接跳到可用EX或普攻；不用空等Q破坏本轮输出。
fallback.en: Skip to an available EX or Basic if not ready instead of waiting idle.

title.en: Three White Thunder slashes on one target for Thunder Smite

input.zh: 对白雷足够的同一目标，连续点按三次特殊技
input.en: On one target with enough White Thunder, tap Special three times consecutively

trigger.zh: 目标仍有白雷；0影需本组足够三层，2影须另检查电鸣替代消耗。
trigger.en: The target still has White Thunder; M0 needs three for this group. At M2, separately track Thunder substitution.

complete.zh: 三次实际额外伤害连续触发后，核对雷殛与剩余层数。
complete.en: After three consecutive actual extra-damage triggers, verify Thunder Smite and remaining stacks.

reason.zh: 作者强调同一目标连续触发；不能将打空、跨目标或断开的三次输入视为完成。
reason.en: The author requires a consecutive sequence on one target; misses, different targets or broken strings do not prove completion.

fallback.zh: 目标离场或连段中断时保命并重查层数；不要为赶进度切人打断本组。
fallback.en: If the target leaves or the string breaks, stay safe and recheck stacks; do not interrupt the group just to follow a schedule.

label.zh: 咏叹华彩 · 状态仍在；加攻另需耗能支援入场
label.en: Idyllic Cadenza · while active; ATK requires an energy-consuming assist entry

label.zh: 协奏狙杀 · 实际命中、绝意或协战次数及冷却均满足
label.en: Harmonizing Shot · actual hits, Purge/support uses and cooldowns required

title.zh: 2影：有余量时继续分组消耗电鸣／白雷
title.en: M2: spend remaining Thunder/White Thunder in groups

input.zh: 继续对同一目标每组三次点按特殊技；按实际余量停止
input.en: Continue three Special taps per group on the same target; stop at the actual remaining resource limit

trigger.zh: 至少2影，刚用终结技且仍有电鸣或白雷；对白雷目标命中才可消耗电鸣。
trigger.en: At least M2, just used Ultimate, and Thunder or White Thunder remains; Thunder substitution requires hitting a target with White Thunder.

complete.zh: 核对每组雷殛与剩余库存；资源用完或窗口结束就停，不强制凑九刀。
complete.en: Check each Thunder Smite and remaining stock; stop when resources/window run out rather than forcing nine slashes.

reason.zh: 2影增加可消耗次数，应先花完现有资源再用EX补白雷；本方案不包含觉醒临界。
reason.en: M2 adds spendable resources; use them before another EX refill. The awakened Critical variant is excluded.

fallback.zh: 目标离场或连段中断时保命并重查层数；不要为赶进度切人打断本组。
fallback.en: If the target leaves or the string breaks, stay safe and recheck stacks; do not interrupt the group just to follow a schedule.

title.zh: 安比长按EX，命中补满银星
title.en: Hold Soldier 0 EX and hit to refill Silver Star

trigger.zh: 能量足够；先用掉目标现有可用白雷／电鸣，避免白雷资源溢出。
trigger.en: Enough energy; first spend usable White Thunder/Thunder on the target to avoid wasting its refill.

complete.zh: 招式命中后查看目标银星／白雷，确认实际可用层数。
complete.en: After the move hits, inspect the target’s actual Silver Star/White Thunder stacks.

reason.zh: EX提供快速充能；扳机冥狱须本次重击命中、有绝意且该类型触发额度仍可用。
reason.en: EX rapidly charges the mark. Trigger Tartarus needs this heavy hit, Purge and an available trigger allowance for this move type.

fallback.zh: 缺能量以普攻或合法闪反充能；未命中就重新找目标，不预记三层。
fallback.en: Use Basics or a valid Dodge Counter if energy is low; a miss requires reacquiring the target, not assuming three stacks.

prep.zh: 窗口前确认驻唱、入场加攻、扳机绝意／协战及目标真实状态；不是每轮都必有Q或失衡。
prep.en: Before the window check Cadenza, entry ATK, Trigger Purge/support and the target’s state; neither Ultimate nor Stun is guaranteed every loop.

prep.zh: 足够能量与时间才继续另一组EX循环；没有资源就结束，不照搬作者满能量演示的固定九刀。
prep.en: Continue another EX cycle only with enough energy and time; do not force the author’s fully resourced nine-slash demonstration.

text.zh: 安比1影EX命中额外连续触发三次白雷伤害，不消耗层数；随后仍按实际层数消耗。
text.en: Soldier 0 M1 EX hits trigger three extra White Thunder damage instances without spending stacks; spend actual remaining stacks afterward.

text.zh: 安比2影Q获得6电鸣；苍光命中有白雷目标才优先消耗电鸣。先处理这批额外次数，避免下一次EX覆盖尚未消耗的白雷。
text.en: M2 Ultimate grants six Thunder. White Thunder hits a marked target to spend Thunder instead; process these extra uses before refilling unused White Thunder with EX.

text.zh: 安比6影按实际六次白雷额外伤害触发涡流；不等于每次按E自动追加。
text.en: M6 triggers its vortex after six actual White Thunder extra-damage instances, not after every E input.

text.zh: 扳机1影改变普通追击间隔、狙击获取量与绝意上限；仍按真实命中和库存决定何时补枪。
text.en: Trigger M1 changes normal-shot cooldown, Purge gain and cap; refill according to actual hits and stock.

text.zh: 扳机2影猎眸来自追加攻击与狙击终结一击；不能照旧攻略将前四发狙击直接算满四层。
text.en: Trigger M2 Hunt stacks come from Aftershocks and the sniper finisher; do not assume the first four sniper shots themselves grant four stacks.

text.zh: 扳机6影狙击会消耗破甲凶弹；属于额外配置收益，本轴不强制每轮长时间站场狙击。
text.en: Trigger M6 sniping spends Armor Break Rounds; this is configuration-specific and does not force long sniping every loop.

text.zh: 嘉音1影开场1000喧响不等于Q就绪；减抗仍需其攻击实际命中叠层。
text.en: Astra M1’s opening 1,000 Decibels do not make Ultimate ready; RES reduction needs actual hits/stacks.

text.zh: 嘉音4影连携／Q后的临时免和弦提示不等于免费核心加攻；核心加攻仍看实际耗能震音。
text.en: Astra M4’s temporary no-Chord prompts after Chain/Ultimate do not prove free core ATK; that still requires the actual energy-paid Tremolo.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.主攻接嘉音快支，核对加攻: 按主攻的快速支援提示入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.扳机补绝意，再反向交回安比: 长按普攻狙击，够用后松开
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.安比接扳机反向快支: 看到安比的快支提示再接
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.安比长按EX，命中补满银星: 长按强化特殊技，命中补银星
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.同一目标连续三次苍光，触发雷殛: 对白雷足够的同一目标连按三次特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.普攻补银星，第四段可继续突进: 普攻第四段命中后继续连点或长按
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.需要时扳机EX补协战，再交回: 强化特殊技命中后准备交棒
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.2影：有余量时继续分组消耗电鸣／白雷: 2影：每组三次点按特殊技，有余量再继续

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按嘉音对应快支提示入场: 出现指向主攻的快速支援提示时，按对应支援键入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切扳机；长按普攻狙击，资源足够后松开: 扳机普通入场后长按普攻狙击；绝意够用后松开，让最后一击命中。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按扳机触发的上一位快支提示: 出现指向安比的快速支援提示时，按对应支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切扳机，能量足够时点按强化特殊技: 扳机普通入场后，能量够时点按强化特殊技。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.终结技：斩空掠电: 终结技就绪时按终结技并命中，随后查看银星。

ROTATION_CONTEXT_TITLES.长按强化特殊技: 长按强化特殊技，命中补银星

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1381: 用普攻命中积白雷；需要补银星且能量够时长按强化特殊技，有资源再续特殊技。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100005: 点按特殊技，等攻击命中并进入驻唱
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.131100012: 喧响到「极」且终结技就绪时点按终结技，等命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.136100002: 长按普攻狙击，绝意够时松开，等最后一击命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.136100006: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，等追加射击命中

136100002: 本步长按普攻进入狙击；绝意够用后松开，等终结一击。按实际资源停手，不数普攻段。
Hold Basic to snipe. Release when resources suffice and let the finisher land; do not count a fixed number of Basics.
138100001: 本步先打到普攻第四段；第四段命中后可连点或长按续招，按资源停手。
Reach Basic hit 4; once it lands, tap repeatedly or hold to continue. Stop according to resources.

1381: 回资源时可用普攻积白雷，或用有能量的强化特殊技补银星；前者不是后者的按键前置。
Basics build marks; EX with Energy helps recover resources. Basic is not a required opener for EX.
